nullable_accessors.name: path
nullable_accessors.evidence: String path = inv.getAttachments().get(Constants.PATH_KEY); followed by the added null check if (path == null)

guard_forms: if (path == null) { throw new RemotingException(channel, "Service path is missing from the invocation..."); }
notes: The patch adds a null check for the invocation path obtained from attachments. The nullable accessor is Map.get(Constants.PATH_KEY), which returns null when the PATH_KEY attachment is absent. case_id=dubbo-npe-c1-5
